accepted.s: The Sustainable Development Goals were adopted through which document?
o: Transforming our World: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
accepted.x: The SDGs were adopted in the document titled “Transforming our World: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.”
accepted.tq: Distinguish among similarly associated international development documents.
accepted.sec: 17 SDGs - goal number to theme, number of targets, adoption summit, deadline

accepted.s: The Sustainable Development Goals were adopted by the United Nations General Assembly during its:
accepted.x: The UN General Assembly adopted the 2030 Agenda and its 17 SDGs during its 70th session in 2015.
accepted.tq: Use the year-session pair to eliminate mismatched combinations.
accepted.sec: 17 SDGs - goal number to theme, number of targets, adoption summit, deadline

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: SDG 10 is Reduced Inequalities. Goal 4 is Quality Education, Goal 5 is Gender Equality and Goal 13 is Climate Action.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between adjacent SDG numbers and their themes.
accepted.sec: 17 SDGs - goal number to theme, number of targets, adoption summit, deadline

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. SDG 1 — No Poverty
b. SDG 2 — Zero Hunger
c. SDG 3 — Good Health and Well-being
d. SDG 4 — Quality Education
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched with SDGs 1 to 4.
accepted.tq: Check each consecutive goal-theme pair before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: 17 SDGs - goal number to theme, number of targets, adoption summit, deadline

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT the title of a Sustainable Development Goal?
accepted.x: Green Economy is not one of the 17 SDG titles. The other three are SDG 12, SDG 16 and SDG 17 respectively.
accepted.tq: Find the odd title among exact SDG formulations.
accepted.sec: 17 SDGs - goal number to theme, number of targets, adoption summit, deadline

accepted.s:
Arrange the following milestones in chronological order:
A. Adoption of Agenda 2030 by the UN General Assembly
B. Rio+20 Conference and The Future We Want
C. SDGs coming into force
D. First SDG India Index
accepted.x: The correct sequence is Rio+20 in 2012, Agenda 2030 adoption in 2015, SDGs coming into force in 2016 and the first SDG India Index in 2018.
accepted.tq: Place the earliest international milestone first and verify the middle years.
accepted.sec: Chronology of development milestones

accepted.s: Agenda 2030 is universal because it applies to:
o: All nations, including developed, developing and least developed countries
Only countries that adopted the Paris Agreement
accepted.x: Agenda 2030 applies universally to developed, developing and least developed countries. Its guiding motto is “no one is left behind.”
accepted.tq: Reject restrictive wording when testing a universal principle.
accepted.sec: Nature of Agenda 2030 - universal applicability, human-rights basis, origin of the proposal

accepted.s: The Agenda 2030 is principally guided by which human-rights instrument and related framework?
o: Universal Declaration of Human Rights and international human-rights treaties
accepted.x: Agenda 2030 is guided by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted in 1948, together with international human-rights treaties.
accepted.tq: Separate the core human-rights basis from associated but different international instruments.
accepted.sec: Nature of Agenda 2030 - universal applicability, human-rights basis, origin of the proposal

accepted.s: The idea of the Sustainable Development Goals was first proposed at Rio+20 by:
accepted.x: Colombia and Guatemala first proposed the SDG idea at the 2012 Rio+20 Conference.
accepted.tq: Test the specific proponents rather than the venue or year.
accepted.sec: Nature of Agenda 2030 - universal applicability, human-rights basis, origin of the proposal

accepted.s: Which outcome document of the Rio+20 Conference called for global goals to follow the Millennium Development Goals?
accepted.x: The Rio+20 outcome document titled “The Future We Want” called for global goals to follow the MDGs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish similarly named sustainable-development documents.
accepted.sec: Nature of Agenda 2030 - universal applicability, human-rights basis, origin of the proposal

accepted.s: Which of the following is associated with SDG 13, Climate Action, in India?
o: National Action Plan on Climate Change and its eight missions
National Food Security Act and POSHAN Abhiyaan
accepted.x: India’s National Action Plan on Climate Change, comprising eight missions, is associated with SDG 13.
accepted.tq: Match the goal with the policy package designed for its subject area.

accepted.s: Which of the following is covered under Goal 4, Quality Education?
o: Reduction of remittance costs below 3 percent
Affordable technical, vocational and tertiary education
accepted.x: Goal 4 includes affordable technical, vocational and tertiary education, along with equitable schooling, early-childhood care and literacy. The other options relate to Goal 10 or Goal 5.
accepted.tq: Separate education targets from inequality and gender-equality targets.
accepted.sec: Goal-specific statements - Goal 4, Goal 5, Goal 10

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding SDG 5:
1. It seeks to end discrimination and violence against women and girls.
2. It includes ending child marriage and female genital mutilation.
3. It recognises unpaid care work.
4. It seeks women’s full participation in leadership.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements describe areas covered by SDG 5, Gender Equality.
accepted.tq: When all listed statements express established components of one goal, test the inclusive option.
accepted.sec: Goal-specific statements - Goal 4, Goal 5, Goal 10

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT identified as a reform associated with SDG 10, Reduced Inequalities?
o: Greater voice for developing countries in global institutions
Better regulation of global financial markets
accepted.x: A universal compulsory gold-backed currency is not identified as an SDG 10 reform. The other three are associated with reducing inequality within and among countries.
accepted.tq: Identify the invented policy among genuine reform measures.
accepted.sec: Goal-specific statements - Goal 4, Goal 5, Goal 10

accepted.s: Under SDG 10, the target relating to remittances seeks to bring remittance costs below:
accepted.x: One of the SDG 10-related measures is to reduce remittance costs below 3 percent.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a threshold figure with nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Goal-specific statements - Goal 4, Goal 5, Goal 10

accepted.s: Which institution uses the SDG India Index as its main tool for SDG localisation in India?
accepted.x: NITI Aayog uses the SDG India Index as its main tool for localising the Sustainable Development Goals and encouraging competitive federalism.
accepted.tq: Identify the authority responsible for the specific assessment instrument.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly lists the editions of the SDG India Index mentioned for India?

accepted.s: The fourth edition of the SDG India Index, covering 2023–24, was released on:

accepted.x: The 2023–24 edition used 113 indicators aligned with MoSPI’s National Indicator Framework.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the number of indicators from the total number of SDG targets.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the SDG India Index 2023–24:
1. Scores were provided for 16 SDGs.
2. SDG 17 was assessed only qualitatively.
3. The Index assessed all 17 SDGs through composite numerical scores.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. SDG 17 was assessed only qualitatively, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the exception to an otherwise numerical index assessment.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog SDG India Index - editions, composite score, top/bottom states, AP

accepted.s: Which pair of States jointly occupied the top position in the SDG India Index 2023–24, with a score of 79 each?
accepted.x: Kerala and Uttarakhand jointly topped the 2023–24 SDG India Index with scores of 79 each.
accepted.tq: Test the exact top-state pair and score together.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog SDG India Index - editions, composite score, top/bottom states, AP

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs correctly represents the bottom two States and their SDG India Index 2023–24 scores?
accepted.x: Bihar scored 57 and Jharkhand scored 62; they were the bottom two States in the 2023–24 Index.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversed state-score pairings by checking both components.

accepted.s: A State scoring 74 in the SDG India Index would be classified as a:
accepted.x: States scoring 65–99 are classified as Front Runners. A score of 74 therefore falls in the Front Runner category.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the SDG India Index performance of Andhra Pradesh as presented for 2023–24?

accepted.tq: Match the State with its score, category and rank without swapping values.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog SDG India Index - editions, composite score, top/bottom states, AP

accepted.s: In the SDG India Index performance of Andhra Pradesh, which goal was ranked first and which was ranked second?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in SDG 7 and second in SDG 14.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of the two goal-specific rankings.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog SDG India Index - editions, composite score, top/bottom states, AP

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the SDG India Index classification ranges?
o: Achiever: 100; Front Runner: 65–99; Performer: 50–64; Aspirant: below 50
Achiever: 100; Front Runner: 60–99; Performer: 40–59; Aspirant: below 40
Achiever: above 100; Front Runner: 65–100; Performer: 50–64; Aspirant: below 50
Achiever: 90 and above; Front Runner: 70–89; Performer: 50–69; Aspirant: below 50
accepted.x: The categories are Achiever at 100, Front Runner from 65 to 99, Performer from 50 to 64 and Aspirant below 50.
accepted.tq: Check boundary values and reject altered score ranges.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog SDG India Index - editions, composite score, top/bottom states, AP
